metadata.scope: Six ordinary, sequential released-versus-pruned observations under the same existing impairment profile; not identical random packet histories, confidence intervals, isolated commit attribution or release acceptance.

release.provenance: Existing frozen prior-src optimized build log, prior-routed-jitter run and PROGRESS/REORDERING_PERFORMANCE_DIAGNOSIS recorded lineage; no new build/hash. Both endpoints use the same released binary.

pruned.provenance: Frozen after independent change adjudication and stateful relative ACK removal;67 surviving targeted guards and normal optimized build recorded by root in PRUNING_CHECKS. Both endpoints use this same pruned binary.

metadata.runner: ./.tmp/reflection/run.py unchanged; existing lab/mixed_workload_probe.py bulk-interactive downloads and lab/bulk_upload_probe.py target-confirmed upload. These are finite HTTP/echo/upload probes, not an actual Cloudflare browser test.
metadata.reset_and_exclusivity: Each unchanged runner initializes router HTB/netem before products and applies all8 epochs. No no-loss/jitter/QoS/outage/return-rate override; diagnostics/native trace disabled. Owned containers had no competing MPP/H2/Xray/probe at start. Existing HTTP8080,echo10022,sink10023 preserved; no compilation or other lab overlap.
metadata.router_directions: Router eth0=10.238.46.30 toward client; eth1=10.238.47.30 toward server. Download impaired profile is eth0. Mirrored upload swaps the whole profile onto eth1, retaining500Mbps capacity both directions. Native tc rate/ceil are bytes/s, not bits/s.
metadata.sampling: Every raw one-second sample is represented in compact series, including router HTB classes/qdiscs, endpoint process rows, aggregate ownership, Product traffic and path/native clocks. Raw service.jsonl retains full management and TCP socket detail. Missing version-specific observations remain null. Epoch/outage timestamps are measured, not rewritten to ideal schedule.
metadata.phase_summary: Nominal probe phases use untrimmed one-second bins [0,15),[15,25),[25,30),[30,33),[33,40). Download bins record client payload receipt. Upload fields named receiver_bin record client-observed sink-confirmation arrival, NOT server receive/write timing or instantaneous wire service; confirmation batching can put63.10Mbps in the nominal10Mbps phase or produce567/511Mbps bins without proving excess link service. Server management Product-I/O deltas are the separate target-write observation. These are coarse probe-clock summaries, not exact shaper-clock boundaries. Full raw/trimmed series and actual router transitions remain; no bin is clipped.
metadata.outcome: Pruned bulk download is substantially above the released control in this profile realization: QUIC0.4765→95.2382Mbps, mixed3.9682→93.1389Mbps. Pruned mirrored upload confirms all676265984bytes at120.831Mbps over44.77418s; released upload does not finish by85s. Pruned maximum gaps are4.922/3.888/6.559s. The pruned QUIC echo timeout30.009→33.009s coincides with the deliberate3sUDPblackhole; zero-gap QUIC service during a full outage is impossible. The pruned mixed timeout17.948→20.951s occurs duringQoS instead. These are not interchangeable causes; no fluent-service or general non-downgrade verdict follows from this finite comparison.
metadata.censoring: Released mixed download's9.00767s gap31.17836→40.18603 ends with unchanged delivered bytes and is right-censored, not measured recovery. Released mirrored upload reached the existing85s runner guard; subsequent sink-close failure follows deliberate product teardown, not a spontaneously observed reset.59965175 of114622464locally accepted bytes were confirmed; no accepted final rate is assigned to this incomplete case. Original probe's5.602Mbps is retained as observed partial delivery only.
metadata.echo_accounting: Each download has one actually attempted socket timeout; later unavailable_after_disconnect slots are not independent network failures. Full attempt timestamps and original errors retained. Success-only p95 can be misleading when successes occur in different phases; phase success/error/unavailable counts are included.
metadata.resource_limits: Process %CPU is lifetime-average sampling, not instantaneous CPU pressure; RSS is process/allocator footprint, not live heap ownership. Higher throughput performs more work. These data do not attribute resource changes or random deployed memory events.
metadata.lineage_and_limits: Same configuration and impairment schedule do not ensure identical per-packet loss/reordering; independent kernel random realizations and offload behavior remain. This compares bundled release/pruned compositions, not the contribution of an individual commit. H2/raw baselines are not included in this six-cell artifact.
metadata.raw_preservation: Full probe JSON, probe stderr, endpoint logs and service.jsonl remain in each raw_directory. Runner output is captured here; authoritative repository path in its traceback is normalized to ./.
metadata.cleanup: Existing runner stops only products in the exclusively owned reflection containers after each case; origin services remain. Final router remains mirrored epoch7 and next run must explicitly initialize it. No next control was started before this artifact was saved.
